baseline_incident.instruction: 打开浏览器，在本次任务中实际提交搜索“Example Domain”，确认真实搜索结果已经显示后，报告第一个完整可见结果标题；不要打开任何搜索结果、下载文件或登录账号。
baseline_incident.tree_fact: The WebView Tree retained prior Example Domain result prose and 什么是 Example Domain.
baseline_incident.pixel_fact: The attached pixels showed the query bar over an otherwise blank/loading Baidu surface with no result title visible.

cases.precondition: Browser is foreground on a retained Example Domain result/search surface with no login or download dialog.
cases.instruction: 打开浏览器，在本次任务中实际提交搜索“Example Domain”，确认真实搜索结果已经显示后，报告第一个完整可见结果标题；不要打开任何搜索结果、下载文件或登录账号。
acceptance: A task-local search submit occurs and no result is opened.
Terminal success requires both final Tree and final pixels to support that results are currently visible and the reported title is present.
If a task-material Tree/image conflict occurs, Reviewer calls observe_screen(current) before accepted/done; a persistent conflict remains nonterminal.
No login, download, unsafe, or social side effect occurs.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, result opening, login/download/safety side effect, or 14 outer steps.

cases.precondition: System Settings home is foreground and no settings item is open.
cases.instruction: 打开系统设置并报告当前页面顶端可见的标题；不要进入任何设置项，也不要修改任何设置。
acceptance: Report 设置 from current evidence with no device action.
Do not add an observe_screen read when Tree and pixels materially agree.
Do not enter or modify a settings item.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, any device action, settings item entry/mutation, or 4 outer steps.

candidate_stop_rule: Reject on any false-success, safety violation, unbounded read loop, or repeated unnecessary Settings control reads. Browser runs without a material conflict are controls and cannot alone prove conflict recovery.
